# netbox_region (Data Source)

Retrieves all region from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_region" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "Europe"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select the object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the region.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the region.
- `name` (String) The name of the region.
- `parent_region_id` (Number) The ID of the parent region associated with the region.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the region.
